title: Improve backend-backed progress indicators
summary: Adds backend-owned progress telemetry and calmer WebView presentation for audio policy, pending-publish drain, publish copy, ETA labels, queue refresh, and progress detail states.
reason: The operator progress review found spinner-like or vague states that did not expose enough backend evidence for long media work, parked publishes, audio handling, and refresh waits.
behavior_before: The WebView could show vague or stale progress copy, publish copy used generic labels, audio handling and pending-publish drain had no dedicated progress bars, and queue refresh could hide existing rows behind a loading state.
behavior_after: The backend serializes audio-policy and pending-drain progress evidence, the status policy renders determinate or stepped bars with concrete labels, queue refresh keeps the previous snapshot visible with explicit safe-copy, and diagnostics/detail rows summarize backend progress fields.
manual_validation: Focused unittest progress snapshot/ETA/contract/static checks, 6 tests - passed
PowerShell Parser.ParseFile touched progress/audio/pending scripts - passed
git diff --check touched tracked files - passed (line-ending warnings only)
refresh_summaries --paths touched files - passed (5 written, 15 unchanged)
rollback_plan: Revert this packet's WebView progress/queue presentation edits, remove AudioProgress/PendingDrainProgress serialization and status-policy bars, and remove the added PowerShell telemetry unit if the new fields cause operator confusion or downstream contract regressions.
notes:
Broad WebView browser smoke currently stops on unrelated /api/ui-preferences POST expectation before progress-specific assertions.
